items.title: Ralph Emerson Brown and Jasper Taylor Interview, 1961-05-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] A band that, uh, Jolly got together for a tour. And, uh, it had been a band that belonged to a man by the name of Eldin or Eldridge or something like that. Do you remember anything about such a band?

ctx.x: Yeah. There was a bandit player, I think, since then. Here, Omar. He had a little here, Little Mitch. There was men driving.

A band that, uh, Jolly got together for a tour. And, uh, it had been a band that belonged to a man by the name of Eldin or Eldridge or something like that. Do you remember anything about such a band? It would be in the, maybe in the late 20s. No, 26, 22. What's going on?
I know him in the handy, if I was to have a band together.
